scrapeMode.title: Scraping Mode
scrapeMode.description: Select the Instagram target mode or keep AUTO_DETECT to automatically identify the URL type.

directUrls.title: Instagram Target URLs or Usernames
directUrls.description: Instagram URLs (Profile, Post, Reel, Hashtag, Place) or plain usernames (e.g. nike, cristiano, leomessi).

searchQueries.title: Search Keywords / Queries (Optional)
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Instagram (e.g. 'luxury hotels', 'real estate dubai') to discover matching profiles, hashtags and places.

resultsLimit.title: Maximum Results Per Target
resultsLimit.description: Maximum number of posts, reels, comments, or search results to extract per target URL.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max Comments per Post / Reel
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum comments and replies to scrape per post.

extractEmailAndPhone.title: Extract Email & Phone Leads
extractEmailAndPhone.description: Automatically parses biography and contact fields to extract business emails, phone numbers, and WhatsApp links.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are strongly recommended for Instagram to avoid rate limiting and login challenges.

customCookies.title: Instagram Session Cookies (Optional)
customCookies.description: Optional Instagram cookies (JSON array or 'sessionid=...; ds_user_id=...' format) for scraping private profiles, follower lists, or full logged-in data.
